data.title: 菲奥娜 · 医院长廊的冷面交错
data.description: 【菲奥娜 · 医院长廊的冷面交错】巴林特综合医院明净肃穆的白瓷长廊间，晨间阳光穿过连排高窗洒在光洁地板上。菲奥娜身穿深蓝毛衣配灰底黑条纹背心的医院事务员制服，双手紧抱厚重病历文件夹快步行走。在与前方迎面而来的白色大褂身影交错的一瞬，她维持着绝对冷静的扑克脸平视前方，内心深处却如海啸般剧烈翻涌着对前辈的炽热狂潮。
data.action: 抱紧病历文件夹与黄昏擦肩而过，目不斜视
data.lighting: 高窗透射的明亮晨光与白色走廊漫射
data.promptProse: In the morning hallway of Berlint General Hospital, Fiona Frost walks past Loid Forger approaching from the opposite direction in a white doctor’s coat. She clutches a leather medical clipboard against her grey striped vest and dark-blue sweater, keeping her eyes straight ahead and her clerical poker face composed at the instant their paths cross. Tall-window sunlight connects both clothed figures with the polished tiled floor and highlights her blunt white bob and long right-side fringe. Frame the passing encounter down the bright hospital corridor.
